MasterTargetSlot.Description: Target slot used to track the owner/master.

FollowDefaultSpotRange.Description: Range used for the initial close-range spot check.

FollowLockOnRange.Description: Range used to lock onto the master target.

FollowSeekSlowDownDistance.Description: How far from the master to start slowing down when seeking.

FollowSeekStopDistance.Description: How far from the master to stop when seeking.

FollowSeekRelativeSpeed.Description: Relative speed used when seeking the master.

FollowScanRange.Description: Range used for scan checks while circling.

FollowMaintainDistanceRange.Description: Desired distance range while maintaining distance from the master.

FollowStrafingDurationRange.Description: Strafing duration range while circling the master.

FollowStrafingFrequencyRange.Description: Strafing frequency range while circling the master.

FollowMoveThreshold.Description: Movement threshold used during maintain-distance behavior.

FollowRelativeForwardsSpeed.Description: Forward speed used during maintain-distance behavior.

FollowRelativeBackwardsSpeed.Description: Backward speed used during maintain-distance behavior.

FollowMaintainTimeoutRange.Description: Timeout range before returning to the default follow state.

FollowSpinPreDelayRange.Description: Delay before playing the idle animation in the spin state.

FollowSpinAnimation.Description: Animation played during the spin state.

FollowSpinIdleDurationRange.Description: Duration to hold the idle animation in the spin state.
